title: Residential Finishing Projects Manager
description_text:
Our client is an established property development group in Malta, with over 35 years of industry experience and an extensive portfolio of residential developments. With a strong focus on quality, sustainability, and contemporary living, the company continues to expand its portfolio of residential projects.
 The company is currently seeking a hands-on and experienced Residential Finishing Projects Manager to oversee the finishing stages of its developments, ensuring high standards of workmanship, timely delivery, budget control, and client satisfaction.
 Key Responsibilities
 Oversee and supervise finishing works across multiple residential developments.
 Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
 Coordinate and manage main contractors, subcontractors, and various building trades.
 Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, workmanship, and project schedules, addressing any issues promptly.
 Liaise directly with clients throughout the finishing and handover stages, ensuring their requirements are addressed and expectations met.
 Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs), trade cost estimates, and programmes of works.
 Measure and certify completed works and monitor subcontractor performance.
 Ensure projects remain within agreed budgets and timelines.
 Maintain appropriate site conditions and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.
 Take responsibility for resolving day-to-day site issues and coordinating the necessary corrective actions.
 Oversee final finishing, snagging, and handover processes to ensure successful project completion.
 Attend project planning meetings and provide progress updates and reports when required.
 Requirements
 Proven experience managing residential construction projects, particularly finishing works and turnkey developments.
 Previous experience as a Finishing Manager, Site Manager, Construction Projects Manager, or in a similar position.
 Strong knowledge of the Maltese construction industry and local building practices.
 Experience coordinating multiple subcontractors, trades, and contractors.
 Ability to assess workmanship, identify technical issues, and implement practical solutions.
 Experience preparing and reviewing BOQs, cost estimates, and programmes of works.
 Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 A hands-on and proactive approach, with a willingness to spend most of the working time on site.
 Excellent communication and coordination skills, particularly when dealing with clients and contractors.
 Ability to work independently, take initiative, and lead by example.
 What Our Client Offers
 The opportunity to manage residential developments from finishing through to completion and handover.
 A hands-on role with direct involvement in project delivery.
 The opportunity to contribute to a growing property development business.
 A dynamic and professional working environment.
 If you have solid experience in residential finishing projects and enjoy being actively involved in bringing developments to completion, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
